sources.facts: Count is body dwords minus one; header bits 7:0 reserved; 8-dword RELEASE_MEM layout; end_of_pipe event index 5; the MEC layout marks ordinal 2 bit 28 reserved.

GFX and compute rings emit PACKET3(PACKET3_RELEASE_MEM, 6) with the TC_WB_ONLY-dependent cache actions, DATA_SEL 1/2, INT_SEL 0/2, qword/dword address alignment and a zero final dword; PACKET3(PACKET3_NOP, 0x3FFF) is the one-dword ring NOP and NOP headers are capped at count 0x3FFE; KIQ fences use WRITE_DATA.

adaptation: Original portable checked C++ field packing written from the published definitions and the GFX9 fence generation path. No upstream function body was copied.
additional_software_policy: Emit count 0x3FFF only as the plain one-dword NOP 0xFFFF1000; reject it for NOP bodies and treat it as unsupported for other opcodes and compute-bit NOPs.
Reject header bits 7:0 other than the PACKET3_COMPUTE bit.
Never mask opcode or count, so out-of-range values cannot alias another packet.
Encode only the RELEASE_MEM variants gfx_v9_0_ring_emit_fence emits; reject the compute-bit form, EOP_EXEC and other documented selectors.
Require fence addresses below the 48-bit AMDGPU_GMC_HOLE_START and reject 32-bit fences whose sequence exceeds 32 bits.
Decode only the exact encoder image and leave output unchanged on every error.
unsupported_missing_facts: GFX10/11/12 packet formats: nvd.h and the gfx_v10/v11/v12 generators were not inspected.
PCI device or GC IP version to format mapping: amdgpu_discovery.c was not inspected.
Addresses at or above AMDGPU_GMC_HOLE_START and the 57-bit layout: whether CP RELEASE_MEM consumes the sign-extended or hole-masked form is not established.
EOP_EXEC: soc15d.h and gfx_v9_0.c use bit 28 for trailing fences while the KFD MEC layout marks it reserved.
DST_SEL TC/L2, INT_SEL 1 and 3-6, DATA_SEL 0 and 3-5, other events, STREAM cache policy and volatile/write-combine actions are not emitted by the inspected GFX9 fence path.
EOP interrupt routing, IH decoding, int_ctxid meaning and KIQ WRITE_DATA fences.
